note: Standing-context byte budgets (spec 2026-08-03, `pnpm context:check`). Every byte musterd injects into a seat's context — tools/list render, primer, hook nudges — measured statically from source-of-truth exports. Raising any budget requires replacing that item's `justification`. bytes are UTF-8 of the model-readable text; estTokens = bytes/4 (the SurfaceRender formula).

toolsListDefaultBytes.justification: 2026-10-05 (19238 B, ADR 514 inc 3 agent style: `team_style` + `team_style_set` — a human's own dials over four enum fields, descriptions cut to one line each — costing 808 B over the 2026-09-30 budget), no headroom added: this buys only the two tools. Pays rent via ADR 514's eval (inc 6 readout, 30 days after inc 3: humans with a dial set, `length` split on acts to them); falsifier: no human sets a dial by then → the two tools leave and the bytes come back. Previous: 2026-09-30 (18428 B, ADR 487 nothing-vanishes: `follows_up` on lane_submit and lane_resolve and `abandon_reason` on lane_update, all three undescribed — the daemon's refusal teaches the shape when a lane declares itself one part of several — costing 88 B over the 2026-09-28 budget) + 2 B, deliberately NOT +5%, as ADR 466's raise: this buys only the three fields. Pays rent via ADR 487 eval (no declared increment, follow-up or to-do left with no lane or disposition, docs/watches/2026-09-30-nothing-vanishes.md). Previous: 2026-09-28 (18331 B, ADR 466 `parked` lane state: +`parked` in every lane-state enum and `park_reason`/`park_until` on lane_update, left undescribed to cost 44 B over the 2026-08-27 budget) + 9 B, deliberately NOT +5%: main had already spent the old headroom, and this raise should buy only the parked state. Pays rent via ADR 466 eval (a shelved lane no longer offered to, or claimable by, agents). Re-baseline with headroom at the next deliberate trim.

toolsListMutedBytes.justification: 2026-10-05 (8098 B, ADR 514 inc 3: `team_style` (read) stays on a muted seat — `team_style_set` is in WRITE_TOOLS and drops — costing 56 B over the 2026-09-03 budget), no headroom added. Same rent and falsifier as toolsListDefaultBytes. Previous: 2026-09-03 re-baseline (7659 B) + 5% headroom. Two things bought this raise, and the second is the reason it is a re-baseline rather than a bump: (1) `team_join {wait}` (ADR 095) costs 91 B and pays rent by removing a measured stall — of 33 claim requests opened from an MCP surface since 2026-07-03, only 5 were decided inside the 120s block the argument makes optional (docs/wiki/claim-approval-latency.md); (2) the prior budget was set 2026-08-27 at 7232 B + 5%, and main had drifted to 7568 B by 2026-09-03 — 336 of its 362 B headroom spent by unattributed growth, so the next byte from any source was going to fail this gate whoever added it. Falsify the rent: if no seat uses `wait: 0` by the next re-baseline, cut the argument and take the bytes back.

primerBytes.justification: 2026-10-05 (2824 B, ADR 514 via ADR 085 layering: the one pointer at the style block — `team_join` or the first `team_inbox_check` shows it once and again on change — folded into the join bullet so the 35-line cap holds; +102 B; the skill's eight-line push-back bullet left at the same time, so the seat's standing context is net smaller), no headroom added. Previous: 2026-09-30 (2722 B, ADR 487 via ADR 085 layering: the "several-step plan is a Goal with every step's lane" rule moves INTO the primer because planning has no cue to open the skill, so a skill-only rule never fires; +57 B, folded into the existing lane bullet so the 35-line cap holds), no headroom added — this buys only the one clause. Previous: post-trim 2026-08-03 (2538 B) + 5% headroom
